$comment: Configuration of the automated reviewer (scripts/review). Read from the PR's target branch. REVIEW_API_BASE_URL and REVIEW_MODEL (repository variables) override baseUrl and model of the 'standard' and 'light' tiers; REVIEW_MODEL_VERSION pins the new model's version. pinnedVersion is the model each tier was measured with by the canary: the API has no dated ids, so the reviewer checks the provider's model list and the reply, and stops when an alias now serves another model. pinnedFingerprint (DeepSeek's system_fingerprint): when the backend changes, the report warns and the reviewer opens one issue per new fingerprint; the review goes on.

trivial.$comment: Trivial PR = every file matches 'paths', none matches 'exceptPaths' or sensitivePaths. mode: 'light' (light tier) or 'none' (secret detectors only). Documents that agents read as instructions go in exceptPaths.

autoFix.$comment: What the implementer may fix on its own after a review (AGENTS.md, "Handle the review"; scripts/review/triage.ts). These paths and caps only add to the defaults in scripts/review/lib.ts (invariants, golden set, eval thresholds, AGENTS.md, REVIEW.md, the invariant guard, migrations, .github, .claude, CODEOWNERS; 5 fixes, 10 files), never loosen them.

standard.$comment: deepseek-flash = DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, measured by the canary on 2026-10-23. DeepSeek has no dated id: its /models lists the name below, and a new release under the same name only changes the fingerprint (a warning and an issue). The measured alternative is deepseek-v4-pro (V4-Pro-0813): docs/WORKFLOW.md, "DeepSeek options".

light.$comment: Same model as standard, with short reasoning: for trivial PRs.
